cidrs.description: CIDR ranges (IPv4 or IPv6) whose source IPs belong to this NAD group.

nad_groups.description: Named NAD groups mapping a label to CIDR membership criteria. Referenced from rule nad_groups fields.

shell_start_groups.description: Shell-start attributes keyed by group name (case-insensitive). Checked when the user has no entry in shell_start; first matching group wins.

device_flow_exclude_users.description: Usernames or glob patterns (single * wildcard) that bypass RFC 8628 device flow and use password auth instead. Case-insensitive. Use for service accounts that cannot complete browser authentication (e.g. 'svc-tenable', 'svc-*').

ascii_user_prompts.description: Per-user overrides for username prompt; keys are usernames (case-insensitive).

ascii_password_prompts.description: Per-user overrides for password prompt; keys are usernames (case-insensitive).

ascii_port_prompts.description: Per-port overrides for username prompt; keys are port strings.

ascii_remaddr_prompts.description: Per-remote-address overrides for username prompt; keys are rem_addr strings.

allow_raw_server_msg.description: When false, auth replies carrying raw server_msg bytes will be blocked/errored.

raw_server_msg_allow_prefixes.description: Optional list of hex prefixes that are allowed for raw server_msg; if set, raw messages must match one of these prefixes.

raw_server_msg_deny_prefixes.description: Optional list of hex prefixes that are denied for raw server_msg; deny takes precedence over allow.

raw_server_msg_user_overrides.description: Per-user overrides for raw server_msg enforcement; keys are usernames (case-insensitive).

users.description: Usernames (case-insensitive) this rule applies to. If absent, rule applies to all users.

groups.description: Group names (case-insensitive) this rule applies to. If absent, rule applies to all groups.

nad_groups.description: NAD group names this rule applies to. If absent, rule applies to all NADs. Groups must be defined in the top-level nad_groups map.

days.description: Days of the week this rule is active (UTC). Empty = all days. Accepts 3-letter names, full names, or 'weekdays'/'weekends'.

hours.description: UTC time range HH:MM-HH:MM during which this rule is active. Ranges wrapping midnight (e.g. '22:00-06:00') are supported.

schedule.description: Optional time-based restriction. When present, the rule only fires within the specified UTC day(s) and/or hour range.
